Two German sites opened enrollment for the trial

The early cohort is intended to assess safety; no safety findings were disclosed.
This is the planned main study cohort; enrollment and efficacy results remain pending.
More sites in Israel and Germany expected to open
Further site activation could support recruitment, but timing and enrollment progress were not quantified.

This is an operational milestone in an ongoing Phase 2/3 clinical program, not a report of trial results. The next catalyst would be patient enrollment and subsequent safety or efficacy data from the study.
